fields.reason: The paper explicitly compares a retrieval-augmented system (R) with a baseline model answering without retrieval (B) on the same benchmark.

selector.exact: We include the vanilla LLM, which is prompted with the question and nothing else; we denote it by B. We include the retrieval-augmented generator, which is given the top passages of a dense retriever together with the question; we denote it by R.
selector.suffix: We include the RAG with random
